answer: In this PoA design, each identity posts bonded collateral in a separate escrow, but correlated equivocation links their evidence and triggers a quadratic penalty: for k coordinated identities, aggregate slashing grows as O(k^2), while asymmetric depreciation makes detected sybil control impose an exponential multiplier on capital loss. A jetty, zephyr, or kernel label cannot mask shared behavior; only independently consistent votes preserve stake.
